source_doc: Annual Budget Report 2026-27 (Full Council 26 Feb 2026), incl. Appendix 2 Cabinet Report Jan 2026; savings = Appendix B 'Budget pressure mitigations'.
council_tax_decision: Raised 3.99% (county element), below the 5.00% cap; report chose not to raise to maximum. Band D county element £1,970.13. ASC precept portion not separately itemised.
coverage_note: No conventional line-by-line cashable savings schedule. Two things: (a) para 77 'previously approved savings options totalling £7.4m from 2026/27' with NO breakdown; (b) Appendix B 'Budget pressure mitigations' 7-line table £18,040k in 2026/27 (£44,212k MTFS). Mitigations are overwhelmingly demand-management/cost-avoidance in ASC/children/SEND, not cashable service cuts. No RAG (20% contingency held against non-delivery). Net budget £880.0m. NO explicit EDI/diversity, net-zero/climate, comms/PR, consultancy or senior-management reduction lines; report reaffirms Public Sector Equality Duty and Climate Emergency declaration. Efficiency mechanism = 'Cabinet Efficiency Review Group'.
